title: Shopify Products Scraper input
description: Extract public products from supplied Shopify storefront or product URLs. The Actor does not discover stores or use login-required APIs.

storeUrls.title: Store home URLs
storeUrls.description: Public HTTP(S) Shopify storefront home URLs. Catalog pagination is attempted using the observed /products.json convention.

productUrls.title: Individual product URLs
productUrls.description: Public HTTP(S) product URLs such as https://store.example/products/handle. These are fetched with Shopify's documented Ajax product endpoint.

maxProducts.title: Maximum products
maxProducts.description: Global cap across all stores and product URLs. Reaching this cap is successful but truncated.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Retries for transient request failures. Deterministic 400/401/403/404 responses are not retried unchanged.

maxConcurrencyPerDomain.title: Per-domain concurrency
maxConcurrencyPerDomain.description: Bound on simultaneous requests to one domain.
